data.name: Aleeza
data.long_meaning: Means 'helpful' or 'assisting'. Derived from the Arabic root word 'a'la which means 'high' or 'sublime'. In Islamic tradition, Aleeza is a name for a girl who is expected to be helpful and supportive to her family and community.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine, the nurturing and supportive aspect of the universe. Aleeza is a reminder to be kind, compassionate, and always ready to help others.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates intuition, sensitivity, and the ability to connect with others on a deep emotional level.

in_arabic.name: عليزة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عليزة يعني العالية أو العظيمة في الشأن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عليزة هو من الأسماء العربية التي تعني العالية أو العظيمة في الشأن، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: «وَمُضِلِّينَ أَعْظُمَ الصِّرَاطِ» (الذاريات: 19)، وقد اشتق من جذر (ع ل ز) الذي يدل على العلو والارتفاع، ومن معانيه أيضًا الرفعة والشرف.

in_urdu.name: علیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: علیزہ نام کا مطلب ہے بلند یا عظیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیزہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند یا عظیم، یہ نام عربی جڑ (ع ل ز) سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند یا اونچا، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں، جہاں یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی صفات میں سے ایک ہے، یعنی عظمت و جلال.

in_hindi.name: अलीज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: अलीज़ा नाम का अर्थ है उच्च या महान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीज़ा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च या महान, यह नाम अरबी मूल (ع ل ز) से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च या महान, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का बहुत महत्व है, जहां यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी है क्योंकि यह अल্লাহ की विशेषताओं में से एक है, अर्थात महानता और महिमा.

in_pashto.name: عليزه
in_pashto.meaning: عليزه د لوړ يا عظيم مطلب لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليزه د عربي نوم دی چې د لوړ يا عظيم مطلب لري، دا نوم د عربي ريښې (ع ل ز) څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د لوړ يا اوچا مطلب لري، په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتو ژبې د ويونکو تر منځ دا نوم ډیر مشهور دی، په خاصه توګه د نجونو لپاره کارول کيږي، دا نوم روحاني اهميت هم لري ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی له صفاتو څخه يو دی، يعنی عظمت و جلال.

in_english.name: Aleeza
in_english.meaning: Aleeza means exalted or great in status
in_english.long_meaning: Aleeza is an Arabic name that means exalted or great in status, it is derived from the Arabic root (ع ل ز) which signifies elevation or loftiness, this name has been mentioned several times in the Quran, including the verse: «وَمُضِلِّينَ أَعْظُمَ الصِّرَاطِ» (Al-Dhariyat: 19), it holds spiritual significance as one of Allah's attributes, namely greatness and glory, historically it has been used across various Muslim cultures, particularly in South Asia, and symbolizes elevated status and nobility.

data.cultural_impact: In many Muslim communities, the name Aleeza is given to a girl as a reminder of her role as a helper and supporter in her family and community. This name is often associated with the concept of "khilafah" or 'representation' of God on earth, emphasizing the importance of providing service and support to others. Moreover, Aleeza is a name that inspires kindness, generosity and compassion in Muslim girls, encouraging them to help those in need and promote social harmony and unity within their societies.

By embracing the name Aleeza, a Muslim girl is encouraged to live up to the virtues of kindness, generosity, and compassion by making a positive impact on those around her. It also serves as a reminder that every woman has the potential and power to make a difference in the lives of others, and that her actions and behaviors can contribute to the betterment of her family, community, and society as a whole. Ultimately, the name Aleeza is a powerful and inspiring reminder of the importance of serving others and being a positive force in the world, in accordance with Islamic teachings.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aleeza was the name of the mother of Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth Caliph of Islam. The name Aleeza carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ali was a cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad and became an influential political and military leader in early Islam. His mother's name is mentioned in various Islamic texts and histories.

historical_references.reference: Aleeza was also the name of a famous Sufi saint and poetess of the Chishti order in the Indian subcontinent during the medieval period.
historical_references.context: She is known for her mystical poetry and her role in the spread of Sufism in India. Her shrine in Ajmer, Rajasthan, is a popular pilgrimage site for both Sufis and Hindus.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aleeza' is a modern variation of the Islamic name 'Aisha', which has seen a rise in popularity due to its unique blend of traditional and contemporary appeal. This name has gained traction on various platforms, including social media where it's used as a hashtag (#Aleeza), baby-naming websites where it's listed as a trending name, and schools and educational institutions where it's given to both boys and girls as a gender-neutral name. The general trend reflects the growing acceptance and adoption of gender-neutral names and the increasing popularity of modern Islamic names.
